verdict.rationale: llama.cpp offers a CLI and a server mode (`llama serve`), pre-built binaries, and Docker support, which are the core building blocks for headless/CI automation, and it is dependency-free C/C++ making it easy to embed in pipelines. However, there is no direct evidence of CI-specific features (exit codes, scripting examples, GitHub Actions integration, or explicit headless-mode documentation) or first-party CI/automation guidance. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation, evidence of headless flag usage, exit-code/scripting guarantees, third-party CI integration examples.
